luff.definition:
n. (nautical) the forward edge of a fore-and-aft sail that is next to the mast
n. the act of sailing close to the wind
v. sail close to the wind
luff.translation:
n. 逆风航行, 纵帆前缘, 船首弯曲部
vt. 将船首朝上风
vi. 驶出上风

luffa.definition:
n the dried fibrous part of the fruit of a plant of the genus Luffa; used as a washing sponge or strainer
n any of several tropical annual climbers having large yellow flowers and edible young fruits; grown commercially for the mature fruit's dried fibrous interior that is used as a sponge

luffa acutangula.translation: [网络] 棱角丝瓜；八棱丝瓜；菱角形丝瓜

luffa cylindrica.translation: [网络] 丝瓜；丝瓜萃取；丝瓜萃取液

luffability.translation: 起重机臂倾角变化范围

luffed.translation: v. 转舵( luff的过去式和过去分词 )

luffing.definition:
v sail close to the wind
v flap when the wind is blowing equally on both sides
luffing.translation: 俯仰运动, 上下摆动, 起重机臂的转动

luffs.definition:
n (nautical) the forward edge of a fore-and-aft sail that is next to the mast
n the act of sailing close to the wind
v sail close to the wind
v flap when the wind is blowing equally on both sides
luffs.translation: v. 转舵( luff的第三人称单数 )

lufkin.definition: n. a town in eastern Texas

lufthansa.translation: n. (联邦德国)汉莎航空公司

luftmensch.translation: n. 不切实际的空想家, 梦想家

luftwaffe.translation: n. <德>(纳粹时代的)德国空军
